name: labs/tiagocoutinho__vacuubrand
title: Vacuubrand DCP 3000 vacuum controller
intro: Vacuubrand DCP 3000 vacuum controller, adapted from tiagocoutinho/vacuubrand. It reads `pressure`, `transducer_pressures`, `configuration`, `errors` and 2 more; sets `event_time_interval`, `on_setpoint_1`, `off_setpoint_1`, `on_setpoint_2` and 5 more; runs `measure_pressure`, `switch_on`, `switch_off`, `open_venting_valve` and 2 more. `measure_pressure`: measure absolute, gauge or differential pressure at a declared port and return the value with its reference and timestamp. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
